findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices.
findings.comment: The mobile unit's water stopped functioning during the inspection and the operators used a food-grade hose to connect to a non-food-grade hose to run water from the facility to their mobile unit. A follow up is scheduled for 12/19/2026 to ensure that any hoses that are used for water are food-grade.
findings.citation_text: 5-201.11 Approved. (A) A PLUMBING SYSTEM and hoses conveying water shall be constructed and repaired with APPROVED materials according to LAW. P

findings.title: Hot and cold water available; adequate pressure.
findings.comment: The PIC stated that they repaired the issue that was causing the hot water to not function properly, but there was still observed to be no hot water coming from the sinks during the inspection. A follow up is scheduled for 12/19/2026 to ensure that there is hot water available from the sinks in the mobile unit.
findings.citation_text: 5-103.11(B) Capacity. (B) Hot water generation and distribution systems shall be sufficient to meet the peak hot water demands throughout the food establishment.
